Hello! I'm Emily, a recruiter with Brightline Digital Marketing. We saw your profile and think you would be perfect for our flexible remote position.

The work is simple: help merchants boost their products by completing app optimization tasks on our platform from your phone. You complete 2 sets of 40 tasks a day and earn a commission for each task, about $200 to $800 a day. Training is provided by your personal mentor.

Some days you will receive combination tasks with higher commission. To process them you will need to recharge your account with USDT, and your full balance plus the commission can then be withdrawn.

No interview required. If you are interested, please contact my colleague on Telegram: @brightline_hr_amy
